bill.title: The Housing Voucher Funding Reallocation Act

action.description: Referred to the House Committee on Financial Services.

posted_text:
💵 US HR 9584 — Unused Housing Vouchers Shift to Public Housing Agencies

The bill directs the Department of Housing and Urban Development to redistribute any leftover money from tenant-based assistance programs to public housing agencies struggling to provide these services.

July 2, 2026: Referred to the House Committee on Financial Services.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/house-bill/9584
